item.title: RequireTestFile ignores tests/Unit and tests/Feature in Laravel apps

issues.title: RequireTestFile ignores tests/Unit and tests/Feature in Laravel apps
issues.body:
`RequireTestFileSniff` looks for a class's test only at `tests/{path}/{name}Test.php`. Laravel apps split tests into `tests/Unit` and `tests/Feature`, so a class that has a test still gets a warning.

## Example

crossbible has `app/Providers/AppServiceProvider.php`, and its test is `tests/Unit/Providers/AppServiceProviderTest.php`. The sniff expects `tests/Providers/AppServiceProviderTest.php` and warns `RequireTestFile.Missing`.

Every Laravel app that gets `phpcs.xml` from `mike-bronner/laravel-development-settings` hits this, because that file runs `<rule ref="CleanCode"/>` with the default properties.

## Expected

A test under `tests/Unit/` or `tests/Feature/` at the same relative path counts as the class's test. The default `tests/{path}/{name}Test.php` keeps working for packages.

## Notes

`testPathTemplate` is a single pattern, so a project cannot list both locations today. Options include a list of templates or a glob across the first level under `tests/`.

held_acceptance_criteria:
<!-- acceptance-criteria -->

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] With default properties, a concrete class at `app/Providers/AppServiceProvider.php` whose only test is `tests/Unit/Providers/AppServiceProviderTest.php` gets no `RequireTestFile.Missing` warning.
- [ ] With default properties, the same class gets no warning when its only test is `tests/Feature/Providers/AppServiceProviderTest.php`.
- [ ] With default properties, a class under `src/` behaves the same way: `src/Foo/Bar.php` with only `tests/Unit/Foo/BarTest.php` gets no warning.
- [ ] With default properties, a class directly under a source root gets no warning when its only test sits directly under a suite directory. The existing fixture `src/Split.php` with `tests/Unit/SplitTest.php` is this case.
- [ ] With default properties, a test at `tests/{path}/{name}Test.php` still counts, so a package layout keeps passing.
- [ ] With default properties, a test at the mirrored path under any other directory directly below `tests/` also counts, for example `tests/Integration/Providers/AppServiceProviderTest.php`. The default does not depend on a fixed list of suite names.
- [ ] With default properties, the sniff still warns on `app/Providers/AppServiceProvider.php` in each of these cases, each pinned by its own test: the only test is `tests/Unit/AppServiceProviderTest.php` (wrong level), `tests/Unit/Providers/Extra/AppServiceProviderTest.php` (one level too deep), `tests/Unit/Extra/Providers/AppServiceProviderTest.php` (extra level above the mirrored path), or `tests/Unit/Providers/OtherTest.php` (wrong name).
- [ ] A ruleset that sets `testDirectory` or `testPathTemplate` to a non-default value gets the single-location result it got before this change. At least one test sets the property through ruleset properties, and asserts that `src/Split.php` with only `tests/Unit/SplitTest.php` still warns under `testPathTemplate` set to `{name}Test.php`. The existing `tests/*` test-root case still passes.
- [ ] The `RequireTestFile.Missing` warning names each location pattern the sniff checked. A test on `src/Untested.php` under defaults asserts the message contains both the package-layout path and the suite-directory form. The source code `RequireTestFile.Missing` is unchanged.
- [ ] A source path containing a glob metacharacter never counts an unrelated test under a suite directory as its test. One test pins a negative case, such as `src/Od*d.php` with only `tests/Unit/OdadTest.php`, which must warn. One test pins a positive case, such as `src/Odd[Name].php` with `tests/Unit/Odd[Name]Test.php`, which must not warn.
- [ ] Every existing case in `tests/Standards/RequireTestFileTest.php` passes unmodified, except the `src/Split.php` row under "a test below the configured test root". That row is moved to the no-warning side and its label describes the new behavior. No existing test is deleted. This keeps the exemptions (abstract classes, `excludePatterns`, `STDIN`, paths outside `sourceDirectories`) and the no-`tests/`-directory case covered.
- [ ] The README entry for `CleanCode.Testing.RequireTestFile` lists the default test locations literally, and says that a custom `testDirectory` or `testPathTemplate` replaces them.
- [ ] `composer test`, `composer lint`, and `composer lint:self` pass, with no new `phpcs:ignore`, no skipped tests, and no new ruleset exclusions.
